div.div: مُرَيَّقٌ One in whom a thing ceases not to induce wonder, or admiration, and pleasure, or joy; or whom a thing ceases not to please, or rejoice: (K:) occurring in a verse of Ru-beh: but Sgh says that it should by rule be مُرَوَّقٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
